term: fixed actual BCCP, proposition involvement and personal explanation in #8
definition: BCCP collects the contingently true propositions of the actual world. The same target is retained when explanation is said to be possible. A proposition involving a necessary being and reporting a personal explanation is not thereby identified with a true necessary fact, an actually existing concrete bearer or an exercised cause.
note: Source-only glossary. All-true coverage, aggregate admission, explanation actuality, involvement-to-bearer and personal-explanation interpretation remain open. S5 is displayed by the source, not certified here as an actuality-of-explanans rule.
